info.title: FoxMind P3.1 account/session contract
info.description: Design artifact only. Identity routes are NOT implemented; current NestJS app exposes health endpoints. Product policies are confirmed in the functional specification; see accounts-sessions.md for atomicity, transport, abuse and mail-secret handling. No live credential examples.

Name.description: Count raw Unicode code points, including surrounding spaces. Reject whitespace-only; do not trim oversized input into validity.

Email.description: Valid email with an already-lowercase domain; reject uppercase domains with 422 before durable issuance or SMTP, do not silently lowercase. Trim outer email whitespace for canonical lookup and compare case-insensitively. Preserve accepted delivery spelling, including local-part case, dots and plus. No provider-specific rewrites. Explicit P3.2 user amendment.

Password.description: Valid Unicode scalar input, counted in code points. No trimming, normalization, truncation or extra character-class composition.

AccountToken.description: Opaque canonical base64url encoding of32random bytes. Purpose/user/expiry/single-use state checked on server. Never log or return in API success bodies.

csrfToken.description: Session-bound HMAC, not the raw session verifier; obtain again after rotation.

BadLink.description: 400: LINK_INVALID for wrong purpose/account, expired, consumed or invalidated token; no account/session/token mutation.

Unauthorized.description: 401: AUTH_REQUIRED or AUTHENTICATION_FAILED as specified by operation; no account-existence distinction.

Forbidden.description: 403: ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED, CSRF_INVALID or EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED as applicable.

AlreadyVerified.description: 409: EMAIL_ALREADY_VERIFIED for the authenticated current user only.

TooLarge.description: 413: REQUEST_TOO_LARGE before expensive work;16KiB body cap.

Validation.description: 422: VALIDATION_ERROR; unknown fields rejected; do not echo submitted values.

RateLimited.description: 429: RATE_LIMITED, account-existence independent; no issuance/invalidation/cooldown restart.

Retry-After.description: Remaining wait in whole seconds, rounded up.

Unavailable.description: 503: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE; no false successful persistence/delivery or partial credential mutation.

InternalError.description: Unexpected error, sanitized INTERNAL_ERROR; no stack, secret or account detail.

SessionCookie.name: foxmind_session
SessionCookie.description: Opaque stateful session, hash stored on server; no JWT/bearer/refresh flow. Idle1800s,absolute43200s.

CsrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfHeader.description: GET/auth/csrf session-bound HMAC; required for every mutation with a valid session. Session rotation invalidates old binding.

x-validation-boundary: Raw Unicode code points, valid scalar sequences, no whitespace-only names, additionalProperties false, canonical email lookup; no silent password normalization/truncation.
x-session-activity: Health,session andCSRF polling do not renew idle; activity never extends absolute lifetime. Routine identifier rotation preserves absolute expiry.
x-accepted-semantics: Durable request acceptance only; no delivery guarantee, implicit login, enrollment or invitation acceptance.
